newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Gold closes slightly easier in lifeless H.K. trade.
newsitem.headline: Gold closes slightly easier in lifeless H.K. trade.

text.p: Gold closed slightly easier on Thursday from New York's finish in lifeless trading, dealers said.
"It's been very quiet all day with nothing special happening in the Asian market. The price of gold stayed in a 10 U.S. cent range," said a dealer at a major bank.
Bullion ended at US$380.60/381.10 an ounce against New York's US$380.90/381.40 close on Wednesday.
"Sentiment on gold is mixed and its next move is solely dictated by silver prices in the near future," a deaker added.
Local gold ended HK$2 lower at HK$3,508 a tael.
The carry over charge at the Chinese Gold and Silver Exchange Society rose from -8 to -5 Thursday.
